item.title: Error with unknown cause
item.description:
Hello everyone, I build a SCM-Model using R-Studio and everything worked fine. Now I'm trying to build a new one with more datapoints but for some reason it spits out the error:
control unit: NA ; predictor: [Predictorname] has missing data for all periods in time.predictors.priorcontrol
I checked everyting and if I use summery the data shows up. I did everything the same way as before but it doesnt work. Can someone help me?
